body:
Here is the Mirkwood TR from Tuesday night.  I was playing BHBM with lots of characters and Imperial commands for dark (the deck that I felt could most stand up to WYS) and a goofy TIGIHis speeders and x-wings for light.  BHBM I won’t post since there is already about 9000 of them on this site, and lite I won’t post since it really would just waste everyones time to read it.





Game 1 my LLS vs. Herb and his HDADTJ.



Okay I have said a few not so nice things about Herb in the past but over the last few weeks he has gotten much less objectionable to play.  Not fun mind you, I just hate him less now than I ever did.  This game was quick and painful.  I Twi’leked for Honor, and found out it wasn’t in my deck.  Herb flipped on the 2nd turn with Vader Tarkin Mara at the Endor landing site, and the only other site deployed was the Hoth DB.  We had a few battles, but Visage killed me quick.  FL by 33.



highs.  It was quick

lows: where to begin???? the entire game.  This one loss almost made me not post this TR



Game 2 My DS. vs. Louie and his I don’t know.



Okay I think he was playing New age Throne room with DB’s and mains and SA, but he never really did anything.  I play this BHBM without SA since it allows for more characters, and he burned at least 12 cards SAing my stuff which just went to my used pile.  I got early Janus and Palpy at the Endor DB, the battles were very few.  Vader and Tarkin Took on Obi and Mirax once. (maybe twice.) and Mara and Xixor paid a visit to the Home 1 db to see their pal wedge.  Mara got in the way of the door but xixor  (thanks to a tracked 5) taught Wedge the power of the black sun.  at this point I had 3 cards stacked, but he had given me JKLuke so I just took him over and started dueling to try and make him lose 3.  Late game he sent Twass Kah to take on Ephant Mon and Janus.  Lost the battle, and the game since that gave me the last card I needed to stack, and I turned Luke.



FW +22, now 2(-11)

Highs:  Turning Luke this deck is solid

Lows:  Um.. Mara got in the way of as door. He sensed my Circle, so I played No escape to get it back, then he sensed it again.  cost him 6 force, and as I write this I couldn’t do that, since it should have gone to my used pile.

Game 3 my speeder crap vs. Rich j. Court



Okay opening hand I got boussh.  so I never took damage from court.  I just spread out with my speeders and X-wings and out drained him.  NO BATTLES.  a late all wings for 8 helped up differential  FW by 15  now 4(+4)



Highs: Rich is a fun opponent and this was a close game

lows: this is the first game I’ve had in a long time with no battles.





Game 4 my DS vs. Jerome Flynn and his HBSQUASS.



This game was never close.  I used Mob. POints to puill exec. one turn 3 had Empy Janus SIm at endor DB, and just activated force so when he moved to a battleground I could jump him with Zuckass, Thrawn and Pellanon on Chimera and Lateral Damage.  I did, cost him about 10 force plus Hobbie in his ship.  Jerry just drew up after that since I had the Exec. in my hand, and played no escape to get back the LD that he cancelled.  We knew it would be game.

FW by 25 6(+29)

Highs:  one big battle, this deck works

lows: Jerry got spanked, and it wasn’t a nice way to beat a good player and a nice guy.





so I finished about 5th at 3-1 and had some fun games



Props:

Mirkwood for letting us play every week

Justin for helping me team up on Rob and Tony in Raw deal

everyone I played for fun games (although Louie plays slower than molassas in January, thats right Mr. Prust)

the Guys from St. Cloud who keep coming down to play.

Undertaker for kicking @#$% at Raw Deal

Slops:

Louie for playing slow enough that i grew a goatee during his turns.

the kid from St. Cloud for playing Inserts



Thats all for now.



Garrett "Deadbody" Larson

summary: Garrett Larson went 3–1 (6, +29) and finished about 5th at the Tuesday-night Mirkwood tournament in Minneapolis on 20 February 2001 with Bring Him Before Me and a There Is Good In Him speeder deck, losing to Herb and beating Louie Prust, Rich J. and Jerome Flynn.
notes: Date: 'the Mirkwood TR from Tuesday night', posted Wednesday 21 February 2001: Tuesday 20 February 2001.
page_title set: one of several reports titled 'Mirkwood Deadbody Style'.

Light 'goofy TIGIHis speeders and x-wings' linked to There Is Good In Him (a later deck of his is titled [[Garrett Larson TIGIHis deadbody]], July 2001; not this list). Dark BHBM linked (he turns Luke in game 2). Herb's 'HDADTJ' to the original Hunt Down; Rich's 'Court' to Court Of The Vile Gangster; Jerome's 'HBSQUASS' to Hidden Base.
Opponent 'Herb' first name only (other Mirkwood reports name a Herb Macy); not inferred. 'Rich j.' is first name plus initial (probably [[Rich Jeffery]]); no page, not inferred.
'Louie ... thats right Mr. Prust': full name Louie Prust given in the report; no existing page (new). His deck: 'I think he was playing New age Throne room with DB's and mains and SA'.
'Jerome Flynn' (called 'Jerry') mapped to [[Jerome Flynn]]; possible duplicate [[Jerry Flynn]] flagged.
Finish kept as written ('finished about 5th'); winner and player count not stated. Mentions guys from St. Cloud and 'the kid from St. Cloud' playing Inserts (unnamed); Raw Deal games casual.
No full decklist (neither deck will be posted).
